a:r.a:t: ARCHITECTURE AND WORKING OF THE PROPOSED SYSTEM
Farmer uploads a banana leaf photo (smartphone/camera) through the simple, farmer-friendly web interface.
Validates every upload as banana leaf / not a banana leaf before analysis; unsuitable images are rejected.
Resizes image to 224 × 224, converts it to a pixel array and applies ResNet-50 preprocessing.
50-layer CNN with skip connections; transfer learning (ImageNet weights). Extracts spots, lesions, discoloration. Classes: Healthy, Black Sigatoka, Panama Disease, Bunchy Top.
leaf mask separates leaf from background and a disease mask marks suspected regions by colour.
Affected Area % = Diseased Pixels ÷ Total Leaf Pixels × 100. Mild: 0–20%, Moderate: >20–40%, Severe: >40%.
Uses gradients of the predicted class to build a heatmap overlaid on the leaf, highlighting regions that drove the prediction.
Rule-based (disease × severity): Mild – monitor and prevent; Moderate – increase monitoring and manage; Severe – act immediately, consult expert.
Shows image, validation, disease, confidence, severity, segmentation, Grad-CAM and advice; scan history tracks disease progression.
